description: Set a text layer's Path Options (text on a mask path: Reverse Path, Perpendicular To Path, Force Alignment, First and Last Margin), More Options (Anchor Point Grouping, Grouping Alignment, Fill & Stroke, Inter-Character Blending, Variable Font Spacing), Enable Per-character 3D (Animation menu) and Orient Each Character Independently (Layer > Transform > Auto-Orient)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

fillAndStroke.description: More Options > Fill & Stroke (needs per-character 3D off)

groupingAlignment.description: More Options > Grouping Alignment, [x, y] percent

interCharacterBlending.description: More Options > Inter-Character Blending: 1-based position in its blending mode menu (1 = Normal)

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

orientCharacters.description: true: Orient Each Character Independently toward the camera (turns on per-character 3D); false: turn it off

path.description: Path Options > Path: the index of a mask on the same layer; 0 for none

variableFontSpacing.description: More Options > Variable Font Spacing: 1-based position in its menu; present only when a variable font axis is animated

name: set_text_options
title: Set Text Options
